mapper.select: SELECT tpsh.step_id AS treatPlanStepId, tpsh.plan_id AS planId, tpsh.step_name AS stepName, tpsh.status FROM treat_plan_step_history tpsh INNER JOIN ( SELECT step_id, MAX(crt_time) AS crt_time FROM treat_plan_step_history WHERE status < #{status} AND plan_id = #{planId} GROUP BY step_id ) tpsh2 ON tpsh2.step_id = tpsh.step_id AND tpsh2.crt_time = tpsh.crt_time
